name: smarttokensaver
description: Smart Token Saver: picks how hard Claude thinks per message, shows when a chat gets expensive, and compacts or hands off in one click. Smart Token Saver is based on effortless by HeyCubit (MIT).

handoffSkill.title: Handoff skill (optional)
handoffSkill.description: A skill or slash command that writes the Full handoff, e.g. session-handoff. Empty: the built-in one checks git and saves HANDOFF.md. Quick is always written in seconds from the chat.

handoffAfter.title: After a handoff (first choice)
handoffAfter.description: What the handoff bar starts on; it then remembers your last choice. continue: clear and carry on. confirm: clear, the new chat says where things stand and waits. copy: keep the chat and copy the handoff.

effortBias.title: Lean
effortBias.description: -2 cheapest to 2 smartest. Tips Haiku 5.5's close calls that way; sure calls stay. 0: Balanced, as Haiku 5.5 says.

effortFloor.title: Min effort
effortFloor.description: Smart never picks a lower effort than this.

effortCeiling.title: Max effort
effortCeiling.description: Smart never picks a higher effort than this.

hide.title: Switched off
hide.description: Comma-separated: handoff (the footer button), timer (the cache countdown), reason (the judge's line), progress (the progress bar), sounds, swamp (the context alert), hot (the running-low alert), cold (the cold-cache alert). Empty shows everything. The judge's line is off unless switched on.

modelAuto.title: Cheaper model when it can (experimental)
modelAuto.description: on: a prompt the judge calls simple may run on a cheaper model (Haiku 5.5 or Sonnet), never above the chat's own, when the switch pays. It rarely does in a chat that is in use: the other model rereads the whole chat. off (default): every prompt runs on the chat's model.

helpers.title: Subagents
helpers.description: on: every subagent the chat sends off gets an effort picked by Smart before it starts, so a quick search runs at Medium instead of the chat's effort (never below Medium: a subagent's answer goes back unchecked). off (default): subagents run at the chat's effort.

handoffButton.title: Handoff button
handoffButton.description: advised: the button is Compact, and turns into a glowing Handoff when Haiku 5.5 says a fresh chat would pay off. always: Compact and Handoff show side by side.

compactWith.title: Summaries
compactWith.description: auto: Haiku 5.5 writes the summary when the cache is cold, the chat's model when it is warm. session: always the chat's own model.

swampAt.title: Context alert at
swampAt.description: When the "Chat window is getting swamped" alert shows. Auto follows the window: close to compaction in a small one (227k of 267k at 300k), further below it in a big one (507k of 967k at 1M), none under 200k. A percent is that share of the point where Claude Code compacts.

appearance.title: Panels
appearance.description: auto (Automatic): the panels take the app's own colours, light or dark. dark (Always dark) and light (Always light): this plugin's panels only are dark or light; the app keeps its own mode.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Not in Settings. The colours of everything the plugin draws. navy: navy & orange (default). neutral: cool grey. violet: the upstream colour. orange: Claude Code orange. rose: cherry-blossom pink.

layout.title: Show
layout.description: default (Bar): a bar above the prompt (effort, context, cache, the Smart / Default switch, Compact or Handoff, settings). minimal (Buttons only): small buttons in the footer, no bar.

abControl.title: Maintainer only: Measurement control share
abControl.description: With Measurement on: percent of judged prompts that run at the app's own effort instead of Haiku 5.5's pick, to measure the saving. Ignored while Measurement is off.

compactWindow.title: Context size (new chats)
compactWindow.description: The compaction window in tokens, e.g. 300000. Claude Code compacts a chat about 33k below it (at 267k for 300000). default: Claude Code's own. Set by the plugin for its sessions. Where Claude Code skips the plugin's hook, the plugin writes it to ~/.claude/settings.json (backup beside it) and says so. A managed setting always wins.

measureLog.title: Maintainer only: Measurement
measureLog.description: Ignored unless the maintainer tools are on (see README). on: every judged prompt, request and compaction is written to ~/.claude/smarttokensaver/usage on this computer (kept 30 days). off (default): nothing is logged and no control arm runs.
